introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.paragraph1: The internet we know today was shaped by centralized companies. They own the data, control the platforms, and dictate the rules. Web3 is the shift away from that control toward a decentralized, user-owned internet. Web3 is not just a new technology. It’s a new internet model built on blockchain, governed by users, and designed for open participation.
introduction.paragraph2: The internet we know today was shaped by centralized companies. They own the data, control the platforms, and dictate the rules. Web3 is the shift away from that control toward a decentralized, user-owned internet. Web3 is not just a new technology. It’s a new internet model built on blockchain, governed by users, and designed for open participation.

conclusion.highlight: Web3 puts power in the hands of users and Deep Roots is building the foundation to make it real.

items.title: Web 1.0
items.subtitle: Read Only
items.description: The early web (1990–2004) was static. You could read, but not interact. Pages were simple, and users were just consumers.

items.title: Web 2.0
items.subtitle: Read and Write
items.description: Web 2.0 (2004–now) brought platforms like Facebook, YouTube, and Twitter. You could create content but companies owned your data and monetized your activity.

items.title: Web 3.0
items.subtitle: Read, Write, Own
items.description: Web3 changes the game. Now, users can own their identity, assets, and participation. With wallets, smart contracts, and tokens, the internet becomes open, programmable, and user-driven.

items.title: Decentralization
items.description: No central authority. Control is shared across nodes and smart contracts.

items.title: Permission
items.description: Anyone can participate. No approvals, no gatekeepers.

items.title: Trustless
items.description: Code replaces middlemen. Smart contracts handle logic and security.

items.title: Ownership
items.description: Your tokens, your NFTs, your identity is truly yours, portable and protected.

items.title: Native Payment
items.description: Send and receive value with crypto, no banks required.

items.title: You own your data and assets
You participate globally
items.description: no borders, no banks, no bias.
